headerCountMeaning: Base LazyColumn items before repository-backed records. SMS adds one item while the list or queued search notice is visible. Pagination never persists a footer cursor.
scope: Same-record restoration for Members and bounded positional restoration for other supported lists.
remaining: Installed-screen process death and scroll geometry acceptance

memberRestore.reads: One anchored page. Legacy positions use the available first page. Only the current viewport can save its position.
memberRestore.missingAnchor: Use the first page and reset the position.
memberRestore.filters: Keep the saved search, sort and filters for the same owner and group.
